title: Surface the JSDoc-example convention for new exports before the CI gate
goal: PROBLEM: New exported components must carry a MARK block plus a JSDoc @example entry (enforced by tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs in the Harness Self-Tests gate), but agents only discover this convention when full CI fails late in the pipeline, wasting a whole CI cycle on a formatting omission. FIX: Give the signal earlier and make it actionable: document the MARK plus @example requirement in the agent-facing coding-standards source of truth, and either add the JSDoc-example check to the fast local gates agents run before pushing or make the CI failure message spell out the exact fix (file, export name, and a minimal compliant snippet). Acceptance: an agent adding a new exported file learns the requirement from repo docs or a sub-minute local check, and a violation message tells them precisely what to add. CASE STUDY: KainBain task cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567 (uncomplete-task feature) — the new TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx default export failed the JSDoc baseline in CI and was fixed after the fact; see docs/tasks/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567/automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md and review-uncomplete-20261116.md.

1|# Implementation Plan — Early, actionable MARK + JSDoc `@example` signal
2|
3|## Goal
4|
5|An agent adding a new exported component (or any new public export) learns the
6|MARK-block plus JSDoc `@example` requirement from repo docs or a sub-minute
7|local check — before CI — and, if it still fails, the CI failure message tells
8|them exactly what to add (file, export name, ready-to-paste snippet).
9|
10|Case study: KainBain task `cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567`
11|(uncomplete-task feature) — the new `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` default
12|export failed the JSDoc baseline in CI (`tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs`,
13|"the baseline covers every currently-missing export") and was fixed after the
14|fact; see `docs/tasks/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567/automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md`
15|and `review-uncomplete-20261116.md`.
16|
17|## Binding constraints (from SURVEY.md — all Recommended options won)
18|
19|1. **Docs home:** write the rule in **both** the main coding-standards guide
20|   **and** the agent quick-start checklist (q1).
21|2. **Early signal:** add the JSDoc-`@example` check to the **quick checks run
22|   locally before pushing** (q2). The "clearer CI message" alternative is a
23|   complement, not the primary fix.
24|3. **Scope:** the rule covers **any new shared item, even when added to an
25|   existing file** — not only brand-new files (q3).
26|4. **Message detail:** a violation message must carry **file name, item name,
27|   and a small ready-to-paste fixed example** (q4).
28|
29|## Grounded facts (verified this turn, not assumed)
30|
31|- Gate logic: `scripts/check-jsdoc-example.mjs` scans `api/`, `shared/`,
32|  `frontend/src/` (`*.js/jsx`); every `export function/class/const/let/var`
33|  and `export default` needs `@example` in the nearest attached JSDoc block;
34|  pre-existing gaps are grandfathered in
35|  `scripts/baselines/jsdoc-example-missing.json` (currently 680 entries).
36|- Gate failure renderer: `formatExampleFailure()` already names file +
37|  `kind exportName`, gives a generic MARK/`@example` template, and points at
38|  `npm run check:jsdoc-example` — but the snippet is **one generic template**,
39|  not tailored per export kind (e.g. `export default X` vs
40|  `export function f`), and it never shows the offending export's own context.
41|- Speed (measured): `node scripts/check-jsdoc-example.mjs` → **PASS in 0.64s**
42|  on this checkout — comfortably sub-minute, suitable for a fast local gate.
43|  The CI failure instead surfaced inside "Harness Self-Tests" (~80s into a
44|  ~17-minute `npm test` run), i.e. a whole wasted CI cycle for a formatting
45|  omission.
46|- Agent docs today: `docs/agent-docs/KB-Code-Standards.md` ("vendored, source
47|  of truth is this in-repo copy") already enforces `@example` on new exports
48|  (WP-8 section, points at `npm run check:jsdoc-example`), but **MARK is only
49|  implicit** (appears in an example snippet, never stated as a requirement),
50|  and the scope wording ("new exports") does not spell out q3 (new export in
51|  an existing file). `AGENTS-MAP.md` ("Test & lint commands") already lists
52|  `npm run check:jsdoc-example` but **not as a pre-push step**.
53|- No dedicated agent quick-start/pre-push checklist file was found
54|  (`docs/`, `docs/agent-docs/`, `AGENTS-MAP.md` searched); the checklist home
55|  must be confirmed in Phase 0 (leading candidate: a short pre-push block in
56|  `AGENTS-MAP.md` §Test & lint commands).
57|- Compliant reference: `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx`
58|  lines 1–21 (named export) and 59–64 (default export) — the post-fix shape to
59|  copy into docs/snippets.
60|
61|## Approach (make the change easy, then make the change)
62|
63|- **Phase 0 (make it easy):** pin down the checklist home, the exact fast-gate
64|  wiring point, and the per-kind snippet shapes; no behavior changes.
65|- **Phase 1 (docs):** state MARK + `@example` explicitly in both homes, with
66|  the q3 scope and a copy-paste example per export kind.
67|- **Phase 2 (fast signal + message):** document/wire the sub-second local
68|  check as a pre-push step; upgrade `formatExampleFailure` to emit a
69|  per-export tailored snippet; extend its unit tests.
70|- **Phase 3 (prove it):** acceptance walkthrough — a fresh non-compliant
71|  export must be caught locally in <60s and the message must name file +
72|  export + snippet.
73|
74|## Steps
75|
76|### Phase 0 — Recon (do first; unblocks everything)
77|
78|1. **Confirm the checklist home.** Check whether agents have a canonical
79|   quick-start/pre-push checklist (re-search `docs/`, `AGENTS-MAP.md`,
80|   runner/agent prompts for "before pushing" guidance). Leading candidate: a
81|   short pre-push block in `AGENTS-MAP.md` §Test & lint commands. If none
82|   exists, the plan creates the checklist as a small section there rather than
83|   a new file (agents already read that map; a new file risks being unseen).
84|2. **Confirm the fast-gate wiring point.** Identify what "quick checks run
85|   locally before pushing" concretely means here (documented command list vs
86|   a hook vs `docs:check`). Note `docs:check` already runs the JSDoc gate but
87|   also runs slower doc/link checks — measure it; if it exceeds ~60s, the
88|   pre-push recommendation must be the standalone
89|   `npm run check:jsdoc-example` (0.64s measured), not full `docs:check`.
90|3. **Catalog per-kind snippet shapes.** Derive the minimal compliant block for
91|   each `kind` the scanner reports (`function`, `class`, `const`/`let`/`var`,
92|   `default`, incl. `export default function/class`) from the fixed
93|   `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` (named + default examples) and one `const`
94|   example elsewhere in the tree. These become the message templates and the
95|   docs examples — one source, two uses.
96|
97|### Phase 1 — Docs: state MARK + `@example` in both homes
98|
99|4. **`docs/agent-docs/KB-Code-Standards.md`** (vendored page — keep header
100|   intact; edit only below it): promote MARK from implicit to explicit —
101|   every new public export needs a `MARK:` line **and** `@description` **and**
102|   `@example` in the attached JSDoc block; spell out the q3 scope ("any new
103|   exported item, including a new export added to an existing file — not just
104|   new files"); keep the baseline rule (never add new exports to
105|   `scripts/baselines/jsdoc-example-missing.json`); keep the
106|   `npm run check:jsdoc-example` repro pointer. Reuse the Phase-0 snippet
107|   shapes (named + default) so docs and error message agree word-for-word.
108|5. **Checklist home (from step 1):** add one line item, e.g.
109|   "New export? → MARK + `@example` attached (only whitespace between `*/`
110|   and `export`) → `npm run check:jsdoc-example` (<1s)". One line, no prose —
111|   a checklist item, not a second copy of the guide.
112|6. **Attachment rule (both homes):** state that only whitespace may sit
113|   between `*/` and `export` (the `nearestJsdoc` rule that bites in practice).
114|
115|### Phase 2 — Fast signal + actionable message
116|
117|7. **Wire the local pre-push check.** Make `npm run check:jsdoc-example` (or
118|   the Phase-0-verified fast command) the documented pre-push step for any
119|   change adding an export: checklist item (step 5) + `AGENTS-MAP.md` table
120|   annotation ("run before pushing when you add/rename an export"). Do NOT
121|   slow it down — no new work inside the script's hot path; do NOT move the
122|   slow Harness Self-Tests earlier.
123|8. **Upgrade `formatExampleFailure`** (`scripts/check-jsdoc-example.mjs`):
124|   for each failing `{ file, exportName, kind }`, emit a ready-to-paste block
125|   tailored to `kind` (function / class / const-like / default, including
126|   `export default function` naming), pre-filled with the real file path and
127|   export name, e.g. for the case-study shape:
128|   `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` →
129|   `default TaskCompleteToggleButton` + the exact 4-line block that would
130|   have passed. Keep the existing generic remediation + local-repro lines.
131|   Keep output parseable (file paths + `kind name` lines unchanged in form).
132|9. **Extend `tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs`** (`formatExampleFailure`
133|   block): assert per-kind snippets appear (at least `function` and
134|   `default`), asserting file path + export name are embedded in the snippet,
135|   mirroring the existing assertion style (`assert.match` on `@example`,
136|   file, `kind Name`, `Remediation:`, repro command).
137|10. **Case-study regression test:** add a test feeding a fixture shaped like
138|    the pre-fix `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` (JSDoc-less default export)
139|    through `findPublicExports` → `checkMissing` (empty baseline) →
140|    `formatExampleFailure`, asserting it fails with file + `default` name +
141|    a pastable snippet. This pins the exact CI failure from
142|    `automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md` to the new message.
143|
144|### Phase 3 — Prove it (acceptance walkthrough)
145|
146|11. **Local-signal check:** add a temporary new export without `@example` to
147|    a scratch file in scope, run `npm run check:jsdoc-example`, confirm it
148|    fails in <60s naming the file/export; delete the scratch file and confirm
149|    PASS. (Time the run; record the wall time in the stage report.)
150|12. **Message check:** confirm the failure output contains file + export name
151|    + a snippet that, pasted above the export, turns the run green — i.e.
152|    perform the paste once and re-run.
153|13. **Full relevant suites:** `node --test tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs`
154|    (must be 14/14 + new tests green) and `npm run docs:check` (the gate the
155|    script is wired into). No baseline edits: `git status` must show
156|    `scripts/baselines/jsdoc-example-missing.json` untouched (new exports
157|    document themselves per q6).
158|
159|## Testing plan
160|
161|- Unit: extended `tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs` (steps 9–10) — the
162|  primary gate; run standalone.
163|- Manual/acceptance: steps 11–12 walkthrough with a scratch export (created
164|  and removed within the verification; never committed).
165|- Regression: `npm run docs:check`; confirm baseline file untouched.
166|- Out of scope: full `npm test` (17-min gate) — disproportionate for a docs +
167|  message change; the targeted suites plus `docs:check` are the proportionate
168|  evidence. The next real CI run on a follow-up task is the end-to-end proof.
169|
170|## Documentation plan
171|
172|- Changed: `docs/agent-docs/KB-Code-Standards.md` (explicit MARK + `@example`
173|  + q3 scope + attachment rule), checklist home from step 1 (one-line item),
174|  `AGENTS-MAP.md` table annotation if the checklist lives elsewhere.
175|- Unchanged: baseline JSON, scanner scope (`api/`, `shared/`,
176|  `frontend/src/`), CI pipeline shape.
177|- Stage report must record: checklist home chosen, measured local-check wall
178|  time, and the before/after failure message for the case-study export.
179|
180|## Risks / open questions
181|
182|- **Checklist home unconfirmed** (step 1): if agents don't read
183|  `AGENTS-MAP.md` pre-push either, the docs half needs a better home — ask
184|  where agents actually look before pushing rather than guessing.
185|- **Vendored standards page:** `KB-Code-Standards.md` header says keep
186|  everything below identical to the SilverBullet source — the upstream page
187|  must be updated/re-vendored in parallel or this copy drifts; flag the drift
188|  in the report either way.
189|- **Message length:** per-export tailored snippets grow CI output for large
190|  violations; cap full snippets per export (e.g. first N, summarize rest) so
191|  a 50-export violation stays readable.
192|- Non-goals: no scanner scope changes, no baseline regeneration/pruning, no
193|  new CI stages, no hook installation without agent consent.
194|
195|## Success criteria
196|
197|1. An agent can learn the MARK + `@example` rule (incl. q3 scope and the
198|   attachment rule) from the guide + checklist without hitting CI.
199|2. `npm run check:jsdoc-example` is a documented pre-push step and completes
200|   in <60s.
201|3. A violation message names the file + export and shows a snippet that
202|   passes when pasted (proven once in step 12).
203|4. Baseline file untouched; targeted suites green.
204|

1|# Implementation Plan — Early, actionable MARK + JSDoc `@example` signal
2|
3|## Goal
4|
5|An agent adding a new exported component (or any new public export) learns the
6|MARK-block plus JSDoc `@example` requirement from repo docs or a sub-minute
7|local check — before CI — and, if it still fails, the CI failure message tells
8|them exactly what to add (file, export name, ready-to-paste snippet).
9|
10|Case study: KainBain task `cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567`
11|(uncomplete-task feature) — the new `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` default
12|export failed the JSDoc baseline in CI (`tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs`,
13|"the baseline covers every currently-missing export") and was fixed after the
14|fact; see `docs/tasks/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567/automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md`
15|and `review-uncomplete-20261116.md`.
16|
17|## Binding constraints (from SURVEY.md — all Recommended options won)
18|
19|1. **Docs home:** write the rule in **both** the main coding-standards guide
20|   **and** the agent quick-start checklist (q1).
21|2. **Early signal:** add the JSDoc-`@example` check to the **quick checks run
22|   locally before pushing** (q2). The "clearer CI message" alternative is a
23|   complement, not the primary fix.
24|3. **Scope:** the rule covers **any new shared item, even when added to an
25|   existing file** — not only brand-new files (q3).
26|4. **Message detail:** a violation message must carry **file name, item name,
27|   and a small ready-to-paste fixed example** (q4).
28|
29|## Grounded facts (verified this turn, not assumed)
30|
31|- Gate logic: `scripts/check-jsdoc-example.mjs` scans `api/`, `shared/`,
32|  `frontend/src/` (`*.js/jsx`); every `export function/class/const/let/var`
33|  and `export default` needs `@example` in the nearest attached JSDoc block;
34|  pre-existing gaps are grandfathered in
35|  `scripts/baselines/jsdoc-example-missing.json` (currently 680 entries).
36|- Gate failure renderer: `formatExampleFailure()` already names file +
37|  `kind exportName`, gives a generic MARK/`@example` template, and points at
38|  `npm run check:jsdoc-example` — but the snippet is **one generic template**,
39|  not tailored per export kind (e.g. `export default X` vs
40|  `export function f`), and it never shows the offending export's own context.
41|- Speed (measured): `node scripts/check-jsdoc-example.mjs` → **PASS in 0.64s**
42|  on this checkout — comfortably sub-minute, suitable for a fast local gate.
43|  The CI failure instead surfaced inside "Harness Self-Tests" (~80s into a
44|  ~17-minute `npm test` run), i.e. a whole wasted CI cycle for a formatting
45|  omission.
46|- Agent docs today: `docs/agent-docs/KB-Code-Standards.md` ("vendored, source
47|  of truth is this in-repo copy") already enforces `@example` on new exports
48|  (WP-8 section, points at `npm run check:jsdoc-example`), but **MARK is only
49|  implicit** (appears in an example snippet, never stated as a requirement),
50|  and the scope wording ("new exports") does not spell out q3 (new export in
51|  an existing file). `AGENTS-MAP.md` ("Test & lint commands") already lists
52|  `npm run check:jsdoc-example` but **not as a pre-push step**.
53|- No dedicated agent quick-start/pre-push checklist file was found
54|  (`docs/`, `docs/agent-docs/`, `AGENTS-MAP.md` searched); the checklist home
55|  must be confirmed in Phase 0 (leading candidate: a short pre-push block in
56|  `AGENTS-MAP.md` §Test & lint commands).
57|- Compliant reference: `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx`
58|  lines 1–21 (named export) and 59–64 (default export) — the post-fix shape to
59|  copy into docs/snippets.
60|
61|## Approach (make the change easy, then make the change)
62|
63|- **Phase 0 (make it easy):** pin down the checklist home, the exact fast-gate
64|  wiring point, and the per-kind snippet shapes; no behavior changes.
65|- **Phase 1 (docs):** state MARK + `@example` explicitly in both homes, with
66|  the q3 scope and a copy-paste example per export kind.
67|- **Phase 2 (fast signal + message):** document/wire the sub-second local
68|  check as a pre-push step; upgrade `formatExampleFailure` to emit a
69|  per-export tailored snippet; extend its unit tests.
70|- **Phase 3 (prove it):** acceptance walkthrough — a fresh non-compliant
71|  export must be caught locally in <60s and the message must name file +
72|  export + snippet.
73|
74|## Steps
75|
76|### Phase 0 — Recon (do first; unblocks everything)
77|
78|1. **Confirm the checklist home.** Check whether agents have a canonical
79|   quick-start/pre-push checklist (re-search `docs/`, `AGENTS-MAP.md`,
80|   runner/agent prompts for "before pushing" guidance). Leading candidate: a
81|   short pre-push block in `AGENTS-MAP.md` §Test & lint commands. If none
82|   exists, the plan creates the checklist as a small section there rather than
83|   a new file (agents already read that map; a new file risks being unseen).
84|2. **Confirm the fast-gate wiring point.** Identify what "quick checks run
85|   locally before pushing" concretely means here (documented command list vs
86|   a hook vs `docs:check`). Note `docs:check` already runs the JSDoc gate but
87|   also runs slower doc/link checks — measure it; if it exceeds ~60s, the
88|   pre-push recommendation must be the standalone
89|   `npm run check:jsdoc-example` (0.64s measured), not full `docs:check`.
90|3. **Catalog per-kind snippet shapes.** Derive the minimal compliant block for
91|   each `kind` the scanner reports (`function`, `class`, `const`/`let`/`var`,
92|   `default`, incl. `export default function/class`) from the fixed
93|   `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` (named + default examples) and one `const`
94|   example elsewhere in the tree. These become the message templates and the
95|   docs examples — one source, two uses.
96|
97|### Phase 1 — Docs: state MARK + `@example` in both homes
98|
99|4. **`docs/agent-docs/KB-Code-Standards.md`** (vendored page — keep header
100|   intact; edit only below it): promote MARK from implicit to explicit —
101|   every new public export needs a `MARK:` line **and** `@description` **and**
102|   `@example` in the attached JSDoc block; spell out the q3 scope ("any new
103|   exported item, including a new export added to an existing file — not just
104|   new files"); keep the baseline rule (never add new exports to
105|   `scripts/baselines/jsdoc-example-missing.json`); keep the
106|   `npm run check:jsdoc-example` repro pointer. Reuse the Phase-0 snippet
107|   shapes (named + default) so docs and error message agree word-for-word.
108|5. **Checklist home (from step 1):** add one line item, e.g.
109|   "New export? → MARK + `@example` attached (only whitespace between `*/`
110|   and `export`) → `npm run check:jsdoc-example` (<1s)". One line, no prose —
111|   a checklist item, not a second copy of the guide.
112|6. **Attachment rule (both homes):** state that only whitespace may sit
113|   between `*/` and `export` (the `nearestJsdoc` rule that bites in practice).
114|
115|### Phase 2 — Fast signal + actionable message
116|
117|7. **Wire the local pre-push check.** Make `npm run check:jsdoc-example` (or
118|   the Phase-0-verified fast command) the documented pre-push step for any
119|   change adding an export: checklist item (step 5) + `AGENTS-MAP.md` table
120|   annotation ("run before pushing when you add/rename an export"). Do NOT
121|   slow it down — no new work inside the script's hot path; do NOT move the
122|   slow Harness Self-Tests earlier.
123|8. **Upgrade `formatExampleFailure`** (`scripts/check-jsdoc-example.mjs`):
124|   for each failing `{ file, exportName, kind }`, emit a ready-to-paste block
125|   tailored to `kind` (function / class / const-like / default, including
126|   `export default function` naming), pre-filled with the real file path and
127|   export name, e.g. for the case-study shape:
128|   `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` →
129|   `default TaskCompleteToggleButton` + the exact 4-line block that would
130|   have passed. Keep the existing generic remediation + local-repro lines.
131|   Keep output parseable (file paths + `kind name` lines unchanged in form).
132|9. **Extend `tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs`** (`formatExampleFailure`
133|   block): assert per-kind snippets appear (at least `function` and
134|   `default`), asserting file path + export name are embedded in the snippet,
135|   mirroring the existing assertion style (`assert.match` on `@example`,
136|   file, `kind Name`, `Remediation:`, repro command).
137|10. **Case-study regression test:** add a test feeding a fixture shaped like
138|    the pre-fix `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` (JSDoc-less default export)
139|    through `findPublicExports` → `checkMissing` (empty baseline) →
140|    `formatExampleFailure`, asserting it fails with file + `default` name +
141|    a pastable snippet. This pins the exact CI failure from
142|    `automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md` to the new message.
143|
144|### Phase 3 — Prove it (acceptance walkthrough)
145|
146|11. **Local-signal check:** add a temporary new export without `@example` to
147|    a scratch file in scope, run `npm run check:jsdoc-example`, confirm it
148|    fails in <60s naming the file/export; delete the scratch file and confirm
149|    PASS. (Time the run; record the wall time in the stage report.)
150|12. **Message check:** confirm the failure output contains file + export name
151|    + a snippet that, pasted above the export, turns the run green — i.e.
152|    perform the paste once and re-run.
153|13. **Full relevant suites:** `node --test tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs`
154|    (must be 14/14 + new tests green) and `npm run docs:check` (the gate the
155|    script is wired into). No baseline edits: `git status` must show
156|    `scripts/baselines/jsdoc-example-missing.json` untouched (new exports
157|    document themselves per q6).
158|
159|## Testing plan
160|
161|- Unit: extended `tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs` (steps 9–10) — the
162|  primary gate; run standalone.
163|- Manual/acceptance: steps 11–12 walkthrough with a scratch export (created
164|  and removed within the verification; never committed).
165|- Regression: `npm run docs:check`; confirm baseline file untouched.
166|- Out of scope: full `npm test` (17-min gate) — disproportionate for a docs +
167|  message change; the targeted suites plus `docs:check` are the proportionate
168|  evidence. The next real CI run on a follow-up task is the end-to-end proof.
169|
170|## Documentation plan
171|
172|- Changed: `docs/agent-docs/KB-Code-Standards.md` (explicit MARK + `@example`
173|  + q3 scope + attachment rule), checklist home from step 1 (one-line item),
174|  `AGENTS-MAP.md` table annotation if the checklist lives elsewhere.
175|- Unchanged: baseline JSON, scanner scope (`api/`, `shared/`,
176|  `frontend/src/`), CI pipeline shape.
177|- Stage report must record: checklist home chosen, measured local-check wall
178|  time, and the before/after failure message for the case-study export.
179|
180|## Risks / open questions
181|
182|- **Checklist home unconfirmed** (step 1): if agents don't read
183|  `AGENTS-MAP.md` pre-push either, the docs half needs a better home — ask
184|  where agents actually look before pushing rather than guessing.
185|- **Vendored standards page:** `KB-Code-Standards.md` header says keep
186|  everything below identical to the SilverBullet source — the upstream page
187|  must be updated/re-vendored in parallel or this copy drifts; flag the drift
188|  in the report either way.
189|- **Message length:** per-export tailored snippets grow CI output for large
190|  violations; cap full snippets per export (e.g. first N, summarize rest) so
191|  a 50-export violation stays readable.
192|- Non-goals: no scanner scope changes, no baseline regeneration/pruning, no
193|  new CI stages, no hook installation without agent consent.
194|
195|## Success criteria
196|
197|1. An agent can learn the MARK + `@example` rule (incl. q3 scope and the
198|   attachment rule) from the guide + checklist without hitting CI.
199|2. `npm run check:jsdoc-example` is a documented pre-push step and completes
200|   in <60s.
201|3. A violation message names the file + export and shows a snippet that
202|   passes when pasted (proven once in step 12).
203|4. Baseline file untouched; targeted suites green.
204|
